info.name: Syntage Accounts Payable Insight RPC Shareholders Insight API

items.docs:
**Deprecated:** Use [Get Shareholders](/api-reference/shareholders-insight/get-shareholders) instead.

Shareholder information is obtained from the Registro Público de Comercio (RPC) and, when available for the entity, from Company Verification reports.

When at least one shareholder for the entity has been ingested from a Company Verification report, the response returns only the Company Verification-sourced shareholders, and ownership percentages reflect the values recorded on the verification
